source_caption:
🎬 The Last Kiss (2006)

The Last Kiss follows Michael, a 30-year-old man whose seemingly perfect life begins to unravel when he learns that his longtime girlfriend, Jenna, is pregnant. Although he loves her, the thought of marriage, fatherhood, and growing older leaves him questioning whether he is ready to settle down. When he meets Kim, a charming college student, Michael finds himself tempted by the excitement of a different life. As his decisions threaten the relationship he has built, he must confront the consequences of his actions and decide what truly matters. Meanwhile, his closest friends struggle with their own complicated relationships and fears about adulthood. Starring Zach Braff, Jacinda Barrett, and Rachel Bilson, The Last Kiss explores love, commitment, temptation, regret, and the difficult choices that come with growing up.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Drama • Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 6.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 44m • R

🎥 Director: Tony Goldwyn

✍️ Writer: Paul Haggis

source_details.synopsis: The Last Kiss is a 2006 American romantic comedy-drama film which is based on 2001 Italian film of the same name, directed by Gabriele Muccino. The plot revolves around a young couple and their friends struggling with adulthood and issues of relationships and commitment. The film stars Zach Braff, Jacinda Barrett, Casey Affleck and Rachel Bilson. The screenplay was written by Paul Haggis, and directed by Tony Goldwyn. Much of The Last Kiss was filmed in and around Madison, Wisconsin. As with Garden State, Braff was involved with the film's soundtrack.
